<cfscript>
    top = 1;
    if (top) {
        writeOutput('top');
    }
</cfscript>
<cfscript>
</cfscript>
<cfscript>
    one = 1;
</cfscript>
<html>
    <head>
        <script>
            var a = 1;
            if (a) {
                b();
            }
            var t = `line one
  line two`;
        </script>
        <script>
            var long = computeSomethingElse(
                argumentNumberOne,
                argumentNumberTwo,
                argumentNumberThree,
                argumentNumberFour,
            );
        </script>
        <style>
            .a {
                color: red;
            }
            .b {
                color: blue;
            }
        </style>
        <script type="application/json">
            { "a": 1, "b": [1, 2] }
        </script>
        <script type="text/template">
  <b>x</b>
</script>
        <script>
            <cfif useAnalytics>track();</cfif>
            var later = 1;
        </script>
        <script type="text/html">
<cfif x>
<b>#x#</b>
</cfif>
</script>
    </head>
    <body>
        <cfoutput>
            <script>
                var user = "#user.name#";
                <cfif admin>
                showAdmin();
                </cfif>
            </script>
            <script>
                    var id = #user.id#;
                    <cfif admin>
                      showAdmin(id);
                    </cfif>
            </script>
        </cfoutput>
        <div>
            <cfscript>
                // A comment.
                x = 1;
                for (i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
                    writeOutput(i);
                }
                s = 'a string
  over two lines';
                /*
                 * a block comment
                 */
                result = someFunctionNamed(
                    argumentNumberOne,
                    argumentNumberTwo,
                    argumentNumberThree,
                    argumentNumberFour
                );
                ```
                <cfoutput>#x#</cfoutput>
                ```
            </cfscript>
            <cfif x>
                <cfscript>
                    y = 2;
                </cfscript>
            </cfif>
            <cfquery name="flush">
                SELECT a
                FROM t
                WHERE b = <cfqueryparam value="#b#">
            </cfquery>
            <cfquery name="indented">
                SELECT a
                FROM t
            </cfquery>
        </div>
    </body>
</html>
<cfcomponent>
    <cfscript>
        property name="p";
        this.x = 1;
    </cfscript>
    <cffunction name="f">
        <cfscript>
            return x;
        </cfscript>
    </cffunction>
</cfcomponent>
~

					var id = #user.id#;
					<cfif admin>
					  showAdmin(id);
					</cfif>
			</script>

  over two lines';
